data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate reported a gross opening claims outstanding balance of $527.577m (USD). Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of approximately $24.8m (gross), driven primarily by adverse development and IBNR increases across older underwriting years (notably a large movement in the 2015 underwriting year), and influenced by both large man-made losses (marine hull losses and individual vessel sinkings, aviation losses) and natural catastrophe activity. The 2017 hurricane season (Harvey, Irma and Maria) produced significant catastrophe losses (gross c. $109m; net c. $51m) that materially affected 2017 results and reserve setting. Reserve movements by major division show material increases in gross claims outstanding for Reinsurance (Treaty), Specialty and Property, with a small release in the Marine/Aviation & Transport division.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred claims diagonals) as the notes state only the net prior-year deterioration explicitly. The report presents many figures in $000; movements are also affected by foreign exchange (FX) movements noted in the movement tables (FX impact c.$18.6m). A post-period Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transaction is disclosed (15 Feb 2018) which may distort comparisons in subsequent periods but does not appear to have distorted the 2017 triangle. Mapping of internal divisions to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate (eg MAT -> Marine; 'Reinsurance' mapped to Treaty; 'Specialty' mapped to Professional Lines; 'Political Risks & Terrorism' mapped to Aggregate as a closest available standard name).
